channel.title: Lucky Color Today Journal
channel.description: Guides to lucky colors, zodiac colors, numerology and palm reading.

item.title: Lucky Colors for Love, Money and Career
item.description: Which color to wear for romance, a raise or a fresh start: pink and red for love, gold and green for money, navy and purple for career. Plus the best day of the week for each. #luckycolors #moneyluck #colormeaning

item.title: Palm Reading for Beginners: The 4 Main Lines
item.description: How to find your heart line, head line, life line and fate line, and what each one is said to show about love, thinking, energy and career. A simple beginner's guide to palmistry. #palmreading #palmistry #spiritual

item.title: 10 Easy Ways to Use Your Lucky Color
item.description: No need to wear head-to-toe color. Ten small, quiet ways to carry your lucky color through the day, from socks and nail polish to your phone wallpaper. Works even with a uniform. #luckycolor #goodluck #dailyritual

item.title: Find Your Lucky Color by Date of Birth
item.description: Add up the digits of your birthday to get your life path number, then find your signature lucky color and gemstone. A simple numerology guide with a worked example. #numerology #lifepathnumber #luckycolor

item.title: Lucky Colors for All 12 Zodiac Signs
item.description: Find your zodiac sign's three lucky colors, its element and ruling planet, plus your weekly power day. Aries to Pisces in one easy chart. #zodiaccolors #astrology #luckycolor #horoscope

item.title: Lucky Color for Each Day of the Week
item.description: Why does every day have its own lucky color? The seven days are named after the seven classical planets, and each planet has its own color, gemstone and number. See the full planetary week and how to wear your color for good luck. #luckycolor #colorastrology #dailyluck
